great_nebula.title: Capricorn's Great Nebula
great_nebula.description: A large nebula in the centre of Capricorn's Galaxy thought to be caused by the Nexus. Travel to the nebula is extremely dangerous due to its high activity, making it a perfect place for hiding all kinds of interesting regions like the Val Conjunct.

nexus.title: The Nexus
nexus.description: An area of extreme cosmic activity in the eye of [[great_nebula|The Great Nebula]]. Traversing here is thought to be impossible. Hides the [[ajankajo|Ajankajo]] System.

val_conjunct.title: The Val Conjunct
val_conjunct.description: A region under the supervision of [[capricorns_great_union|Capricorn's Great Union]]. The region holds many mythical places, the best example being [[atalval|Atal'val]]. Travel to the region is very difficult, caused by the [[great_nebula|Great Nebula]].

capricorns_galaxy.title: Capricorn's Galaxy
capricorns_galaxy.description: A galaxy with highly developed civilisations and an active Emitter. Many proficient in Äen'e. In the Lynx Cluster.

navigators_nebula.title: Navigator's Nebula
navigators_nebula.description: A large nebula fairly close to the Great Nebula. Hides some systems, the most notable being Lupovalea'i.

half_dead_void.title: The Half Dead Void
half_dead_void.description: A large void in Galactic Region 10, found next to Arven's Realm. Small quantity of active stars. Known for sudden local outbursts of energy, earning it its name as "Half Dead".

ajankajo.title: Ajankajo
ajankajo.description: A mysterious system hidden in the Nexus. Travel to here can be deemed impossible due to extreme cosmic activity caused by the Emitter.

tophu.title: Tophu
tophu.description: Capital system of Atal'val. Administrative capital of Capricorn's Great Union. Houses the biggest ecumonopolis of the Val Conjunct.

lupovaleai.title: Lupovalea'i
lupovaleai.description: A hidden system in Navigator's Nebula. The system is an important meeting point for people of Capricorn's Great Union, and the best known way of travelling to the union's main regions.

capricorns_great_union.title: Capricorn's Great Union
capricorns_great_union.description: The most powerful union in the galaxy. The union is made up of lots of smaller independent factions. Tophu acts as the union's administrative capital system.

olias_union.title: Olia's Union
olias_union.description: Olia's Union is a large union in the Olia Region of the galaxy. Composed of smaller independent unions and peoples. Oliarion is the Union's Capital and houses its senate. The Union's systems are guarded by the OSC.

arvens_realm.title: Arven's Realm
arvens_realm.description: A powerful and large union found close to the Half Dead Void. Arven's Realm is split into five sectors with their own capitals. The union's capital is Arven.

tellusians.title: The Tellusians
tellusians.description: A mysterious humanoid species from far after Capricorn's Galaxy existed.

aari.title: Ääri
aari.description: Another part of a great mystery behind the Universe.

style_and_syntax.title: Style and Syntax
style_and_syntax.description: Style and syntax for the project.
